verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a reporting surface with a defined conversion rate (sessions begun vs. completed) and per-session status in the Dashboard. Drop-off tracking appears possible only by building it yourself from Link onEvent callbacks and STEP_UPDATED webhooks, not as built-in funnel analytics. Missing for 10: documented pass-rate reporting, built-in drop-off-by-step analytics, completion-time metrics, breakdowns by country and document type, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
